_comment: OpenClaw custom command descriptor for the Black Star Legacy render pipeline. Register this with your OpenClaw gateway (see pipeline/README.md section 5). The exact registration syntax depends on your OpenClaw version; this captures the intent the agent needs.
name: blkk_render
description: Render a Black Star Legacy 3D portfolio asset in Unreal Engine 5.8 and publish a 360 virtual tour (and optionally a Pixel Streaming build) to the website. Trigger when the user asks to render/build/publish a tour for a named project.
trigger_examples: render the Modern Villa and put a 360 tour live
I dropped the Lamborghini model in the hot folder, run the pipeline
build a flagship pixel-streaming tour for the Havilah Estate

asset_path.description: Path to the asset; defaults to the newest file in the hot folder

flagship.description: Also build a Pixel Streaming package

returns: The agent should relay the line beginning PIPELINE_SUMMARY_JSON= (or the trailing human message) back to the user over the messenger.
notes: If asset_path is omitted, OpenClaw should resolve the newest accepted file in pipeline/hot_folder before substituting {asset_flag}.
Long-running (UE render can take many minutes). Run detached and post the summary when PIPELINE_SUMMARY_JSON appears in stdout/the logs/ file.
category_flag => '--category <value>' or empty; asset_flag => '--asset "<path>"' or empty; flagship_flag => '--flagship' or empty.
